description: This file defines the BLEHAL class, which provides an interface for Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) hardware abstraction layer (HAL) testing, including method bindings for getting status and enabling features, as well as initialization and cleanup functions.

classes.name: BLEHAL
classes.description: A class providing interface methods for BLE HAL testing, including status retrieval, enabling/disabling, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: BLEHAL(TcpSocketServer & ptrRpcServer)
methods.description: Constructor that binds RPC methods for BLEHAL status and enable functions.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the BLE HAL with a version string.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations for the BLE HAL.

methods.name: testmodulepre_requisites
methods.description: Checks or sets up prerequisites before running tests.

methods.name: testmodulepost_requisites
methods.description: Checks or cleans up after tests have been run.

methods.name: BLEHAL_GetStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the BLE HAL.

methods.name: BLEHAL_Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the BLE HAL features.
